accounts.exhausted_fallback: {name}: Usage exhausted. Puppet Master will use another eligible account until this one resets.
accounts.not_consent: Auto-switch moves work between your accounts. It is not consent to resume a run after its quota ends.
accounts.auto_needs_two: Auto-switch is off until a second account is signed in
accounts.acc_sw_shared: Shared with Settings > AI > Providers & Accounts.
accounts.acc_sw_cap: Each account switches at its own level, or follows its service’s level. Pick one to change it; it is the same value as the account’s row in Settings.
